title: Newsletters — eNewsletter mastheads
slide_intent: Teach designers how an email header can orient a reader even when the publication name needs two lines.
strategic_value: A common program mark and curve can connect departments’ email publications while leaving the title free to change.
demonstration: One- and two-line red mastheads share a left program mark separated from the title. A mail-window example aligns the body to the logotype on a white reading surface.
practical_value: Choose a single- or two-line title, then align the body column with the left edge of the logotype and distinguish the white message from its biscuit-colored surround.

content_islands.name: Placement notes
content_islands.spec: Number the notes for the program mark, browser background, copy field and alignment.

content_islands.name: Masthead specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack the one-line and two-line versions in the middle. Keep the program identifier and vertical separator in corresponding positions.

content_islands.name: Email application
content_islands.spec: Place the email window at right. Mark the background, text column and its left edge with numbered callouts.
